description: This file contains a test case for verifying that numeric constants defined in a constants module can be overridden via environment variables. It uses the unittest.mock library to patch environment variables and reloads the constants module to check if values are correctly overridden.

methods.name: test_all_numeric_constants_can_be_overridden()
methods.description: Verifies that all numeric constants in the constants module can be overridden with environment variables. It iterates through constants, sets environment variables, reloads the module, and asserts the override was successful.
